title: Beacon Ridge Solar Share Sign-Up and Referral Credit Amounts
content:
Community Solar Subscriptions carry two kinds of promotional invoice credit: a one-time sign-up credit after allocation, and a referral credit for each referred household that is allocated. The amounts and limits are fixed per plan.

| Plan | Sign-up credit (one time, after allocation) | Billed subscription cycles after which the sign-up credit posts | Referral credit per referred household that is allocated | Referral credits per customer per calendar year, across all subscriptions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Flex | $0.00 | 0 | $50.00 | 5 |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 1-Year | $25.00 | 2 | $50.00 | 5 |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 5-Year | $50.00 | 2 | $50.00 | 5 |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 10-Year | $75.00 | 2 | $50.00 | 5 |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 20-Year | $100.00 | 2 | $50.00 | 5 |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible | $0.00 | 0 | $0.00 | 5 |

## Questions on the schedule

**Which plans carry no sign-up credit?**
Beacon Ridge Solar Share Flex and Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible, whose sign-up credit is $0.00 and whose cycle count is 0.

**When does the sign-up credit post on a plan that carries one?**
After 2 billed subscription cycles, on the 1-Year, 5-Year, 10-Year and 20-Year plans alike; the amount rises with the term, from $25.00 to $100.00.

**Which plan carries no referral credit amount?**
Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible, at $0.00. Every other plan carries $50.00 per referred household that is allocated.

**What is the yearly limit on referral credits?**
5 referral credits per customer per calendar year, counted across all of that customer's subscriptions.

**Hypothetical total.** A customer whose plan carries $50.00 per referral and who earns the full 5 referral credits in one calendar year receives $250.00 in referral credits that year.
